newsitem.title: USA: Abbott Q2 net in line with expectations.
newsitem.headline: Abbott Q2 net in line with expectations.

text.p: Abbott Laboratories Inc reported Thursday that second-quarter net earnings were $522 million, or $0.68 per share, exactly matching Wall Street expectations.
In the year-ago period, the drug and medical products manufacturer earned $470 million, or $0.60 per share.
Worldwide sales on the second quarter were $2.9 billion, up 7.5 percent from a year ago, the company said.

On a segment basis, Abbott said worldwide sales of pharmaceutical and nutritional products were $1.676 billion on the quarter, up 9.4 percent from a year ago, while worldwide sales of hospital and laboratory products totalled $1.224 billion, up 4.9 percent from the same period last year.

On a geographic basis, total quarterly U.S. sales were $1.77 billion, up 9.5 percent. Total non-U.S. sales, including direct exports from the United States, were $1.13 billion, up 4.3 percent from last year.
"International sales were unfavorably impacted 7.2 percent due to the effect of the relatively stronger U.S. dollar," Abbott said.
